title: Movies: the circus picture and Tip Tap Toe
summary: She appeared in a circus film starring Bessie Love and in Tip Tap Toe, singing Three's a Crowd. She did no more because of a contract dispute.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: There's one thing I do want to ask before this thing runs out Lizzie and that's about this movie You were in the movies?

Oh yeah with this circus I was with out in California Well they hide the whole circus you see and uh it was Bessie Love Bessie Love starring Bessie Love in the Stardust Ring She was supposed to be a big bareback rider you know see and they took the whole circus to the parade and everything and of course on the stage in the sideshow I sang and danced walking the dog with some fellas and then in the back of the tent they gave me a big pair of drawers the fat lady drawers made me hang them on the line you know and while I was hanging them on the line a fella come and whispered in my ear and asked me what they might and I punched at him like I was gonna hit him you know then the next picture I worked in was with Hal Leroy and Mitzi Mayfair I think that was their first picture tip tap toe I played the I was supposed to play the piano and sing three as a crowd but I wasn't playing the piano a guy that was Guy Anselmo's orchestra that was playing for the pitcher so it was his piano player that done the playing but I was just jiving you know but you did the singing I done the singing while she done the dancing
Did you sing in the circus picture too?

Yeah I sang walking the dog and the band played walking the dog for me to dance walking the dog with the fellas and what you sang in the tip tap toe? I sang three as a crowd three as a crowd three as a crowd

No just those two I didn't want no more When was that? I mean after that last one all them lights and things like that and hooting your eyes and then I was misinformed about my contract and stuff like that you know I thought I was gonna make one thing and I was making another
About when was that made? That picture? Did you recall was it during just after the war or before the war?
Oh no that was around I guess maybe 32, 33, 34 only that time You made up in New York? Yes and that's the one I think the Warner Studios around Brooklyn around Brooklyn up there that's where it was
